items.title: Unmasking EvilTokens: Getting to the root of device code phishing
items.excerpt: Investigates the EvilTokens threat actor group and their systematic abuse of device code flows to harvest long-lived access tokens. Provides forensic insights into token persistence techniques and outlines architectural controls to limit token scope and enforce conditional access policies.

items.title: Device Code Phishing is an Evolution in Identity Takeover
items.excerpt: Explores how attackers exploit device code authentication flows to bypass multi-factor authentication and seize control of enterprise identities. The report details technical mechanisms, real-world campaign patterns, and mitigation strategies for IT defenders managing cloud identity platforms.

items.title: Device Code Phishing: Turning a Convenience Feature Into an MFA Bypass
items.excerpt: Examines how legitimate device code authentication mechanisms are weaponized to circumvent traditional MFA controls. Covers attack lifecycle, infrastructure indicators, and practical defense-in-depth measures including conditional access rules and user awareness training.

items.title: Inside an AI‑enabled device code phishing campaign
items.excerpt: Breaks down a sophisticated campaign leveraging generative AI to craft highly convincing device code phishing lures. Details attacker infrastructure, prompt engineering tactics, and how defenders can detect anomalous authentication requests and block malicious redirect domains.

items.title: Joint advisory: state-sponsored spear-phishing campaigns targeting critical infrastructure - SUVAT
items.excerpt: Five Eyes joint advisory outlining coordinated state-sponsored spearphishing efforts against critical infrastructure operators. Covers campaign infrastructure, social engineering themes, and cross-agency mitigation guidance for securing OT/IT convergence points and identity boundaries.

items.title: The risks of device code authentication for AI coding agents
items.excerpt: Analyzes vulnerabilities introduced when AI coding agents interact with device code authentication prompts. Highlights how automated workflows can be manipulated to grant unauthorized access to development environments and infrastructure repositories, offering hardening recommendations for secure agent deployment.

items.title: Foreign Threat Actor Conducting Large-Scale Spearphishing Campaign with RDP Attachments | CISA
items.excerpt: Alerts on a widespread spearphishing operation distributing malicious RDP files to compromise remote access infrastructure. Outlines file execution chains, network pivoting tactics, and recommended email gateway filters and endpoint detection rules to block delivery.

items.title: Sophisticated Spearphishing Campaign Targets Government Organizations, IGOs, and NGOs | CISA
items.excerpt: Details a targeted phishing campaign exploiting diplomatic and humanitarian communications to deliver credential-harvesting payloads. Provides IOCs, email header analysis, and guidance for securing identity providers and monitoring for anomalous login patterns.
